clue.text: Regiment in aircraft, a transporter

indicators.note: the regiment is placed inside the word for the aircraft

parts.note: a fighter is a military aircraft
RE is the Royal Engineers, a regiment

explanation.surface: Soldiers are being flown in a military plane used as a troop carrier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aircraft' looks like the vehicle being defined, but it is the outer piece; the transporter is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A freighter is a ship or aircraft that carries cargo, hence a transporter.

clue.text: Accept all but the last television part

indicators.note: the final letter of the word for the TV component is dropped

parts.note: a receiver is the part of a television set that picks up the signal

explanation.surface: Someone agrees to take a whole TV set except for its final component.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all but the last' removes the final R from RECEIVER.
explanation.definitionFit: To receive something is to take it in or take delivery of it.

clue.text: Force oneself in-it ain't rude on this occasion

indicators.note: the clue says the act is not rude this time, and the letters sit inside those words

explanation.surface: A colloquial assurance that butting in is acceptable this time.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is spelt out inside "ain't rude", after its first letter; the surface jokes that barging in is not rude here.
explanation.definitionFit: To intrude is to push in where one is not wanted.

clue.text: Dependent, one who will not let go?

definitions.meaning: a person who relies on another for support

definitions.text: one who will not let go?
definitions.meaning: read literally, someone who keeps hanging on and refuses to release their grip

explanation.definitionFit: A hanger-on is a sycophantic follower relying on someone, and literally one who clings on.

clue.text: I read about rebel leader, an invader

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are turned about into a new order
the leader of the word rebel is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone reads about a rebel chief who is attacking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges I READ into RAIDE, and 'leader' gives R from 'rebel'.
explanation.definitionFit: A raider attacks or invades territory to plunder it.

clue.text: Just as talkative perhaps having double meaning

parts.note: the prefix equi- means equally, just as much
vocal means outspoken or talkative

explanation.surface: Someone who is equally chatty might be ambiguous.
explanation.definitionFit: An equivocal statement is ambiguous, open to two interpretations.

clue.text: Is held by theologian, one in contempt

indicators.note: the word is is held inside the letters for the theologian

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian
a means one

explanation.surface: A religious scholar is regarded with scorn.
explanation.walkthrough: DD (Doctor of Divinity) is the crossword theologian; 'held by' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Disdain is scorn, the feeling that someone is unworthy of respect.

clue.text: Fraud practised magician?

definitions.meaning: read as what a magician practises: trickery that fools the audience

explanation.definitionFit: Deception is trickery used to mislead, whether by a swindler or a conjuror.

clue.text: Obtain possession of a hundred sheets of paper

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Someone takes ownership of a stack of a hundred sheets of stationery.
explanation.definitionFit: To acquire something is to come to own or get it.

clue.text: One producing another note about a flammable liquid

parts.note: an ace is the one in a suit of cards

indicators.note: another note means a different word made from the letters of note

explanation.surface: Someone plays one note after another while describing a flammable liquid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' rearranges NOTE into TONE, which follows ACE (one, the top card); 'producing' and 'about' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Acetone is a volatile solvent that burns easily, as used in nail-varnish remover.

clue.text: Hundreds are successful before being led astray to lose their importance

indicators.note: the win comes before the rearranged word in the answer

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred
to win is to be successful

indicators.note: led astray means the letters of led wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Winners who are misled end up becoming less important.
explanation.walkthrough: D as 'hundreds' leans on D being five hundred in Roman numerals; 'astray' and 'before' are the indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwindle is to shrink gradually, so things that dwindle diminish in significance.

clue.text: Venom of boy about to be king

indicators.note: the boy's name goes round the verb for reigning

parts.note: Vince is a boy's name
to rule is to reign as a king

explanation.surface: A young prince is full of spite as he waits to take the throne.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the boy's name wrapping round the reign verb, splitting it as VI...NCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Virulence is bitter hostility or poisonousness, so venom in a figurative sense.

clue.text: Taking vehicle over the river in a noisy quarrel

indicators.note: in a down answer the vehicle sits above the river

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
the Ouse is a river in England

explanation.surface: A car is driven across a river and a row breaks out.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ouse is a river in Yorkshire and elsewhere in England; 'Taking' and 'in a' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A carouse is a rowdy drinking spree, a loud and boisterous bout that can easily turn into a row.

clue.text: One with a burning ambition

parts.note: a burning ambition usually means a fierce desire; read literally it is the urge of someone who wants to set fires

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who commits arson deliberately starts fires, so their aim is literally to burn things.

clue.text: To this other arrangement going round the point

indicators.note: the rearranged letters surround the compass point
an arrangement of the word other puts its letters in a new order

parts.note: E is east, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A different plan circles round the main issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' makes HERTO from OTHER, and 'going round' puts it around E: HER-E-TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereto is a formal word meaning to this matter or document.

clue.text: He is simple and callous

parts.note: artless means simple and without guile

explanation.surface: A man described as both naive and unfeeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartless means unfeeling and cruel, lacking compassion.

clue.text: Habit-forming

parts.note: usually means addictive, but a habit is also a garment, and making garments is the craft meant here

explanation.definitionFit: Making clothes such as a monk's habit is the trade of cutting and sewing garments.

clue.text: Dora ran round the country

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are turned round into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl called Dora jogged in a circuit around the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' looks like a journey around the nation, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Andorra is a small principality in the Pyrenees between France and Spain.

clue.text: 'e angered another turncoat

indicators.note: another version of the letters means they are rearranged into a different word

explanation.surface: A dropped-aitch remark that he angered one more traitor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' rearranges E ANGERED into the answer; 'e is Cockney for he.
explanation.definitionFit: A renegade deserts one side for another, like a turncoat.

clue.text: Most men have it to face on waking up in the morning

definitions.text: Most men have it to face on waking up in the morning

parts.words: Most men have it to face on waking up in the morning
parts.note: to face something usually means to confront it, but here it is growth on the face of men after a night's sleep

explanation.definitionFit: Short bristly growth of beard appears overnight on an unshaven chin.

clue.text: Leggy figure?

parts.note: a leggy figure suggests a long-limbed person; read as a number, the written numeral 11 looks like two legs

explanation.definitionFit: The numeral 11 is two upright strokes that look like a pair of legs.

clue.text: One hears of a murder suspect

indicators.note: suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters are not to be trusted in their order

explanation.surface: Someone learns of a killing that looks suspicious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspect' rearranges A MURDER into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The tympanic membrane in the ear vibrates with sound, so it is the thing that hears.

clue.text: Elaborate, previously simple

parts.note: ex means former or previously
plain means simple

explanation.surface: Something ornate that was once plain.
explanation.definitionFit: To elaborate is to explain in more detail, to expand on.

clue.text: It is hard without part of the Old Testament

parts.note: Ruth is a book of the Old Testament
less means without, as in a suffix

explanation.surface: A claim that something is difficult when a Bible book is missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruthless means pitiless and harsh, so hard in character.

clue.text: Remained propped up

definitions.meaning: supported by stays, as a mast is by ropes

explanation.definitionFit: Stayed means stopped or lingered, and also braced with stays or supports.

clue.text: Daily means of communication

definitions.meaning: a daily is a newspaper published every day, as this one is
the electric ... sent messages by wire

explanation.definitionFit: The Daily Telegraph is a British newspaper, and the telegraph was a system for sending coded messages over wires.

clue.text: Left European peninsula for an African country

parts.note: Iberia is the peninsula of Spain and Portugal

explanation.surface: Someone departed from Spain and Portugal to go to a nation in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberia is a West African republic founded by freed American slaves.

clue.text: It is quite a distance, of course

definitions.meaning: on a golf course, the mown strip between tee and green

explanation.definitionFit: A fair way means a long stretch, and the fairway is the smooth grassy route on a golf course.

clue.text: In which not a sound will be heard

definitions.text: In which not a sound will be heard

parts.words: In which not a sound will be heard
parts.note: describes a state or condition where all is perfectly quiet

explanation.definitionFit: Complete quiet is the absence of any noise.

clue.text: Decide to stop the excavation

parts.note: to deter is to prevent or put off
a mine is a dug-out excavation

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to halt the digging work.
explanation.definitionFit: To determine is to settle or resolve something.
